name: IC Sensor — I2C — AMS
description: Cluster of 3 surface-mount I2C sensor ICs featuring AMS LGA-10 and OLGA-8 footprints for gas and optical sensing applications.
selection_hints: Choose between gas sensor (CCS811) and optical sensors (AS7341DLG, AS7343xDLG) based on application.
Select matching footprint: AMS_LGA-10-1EP_2.7x4mm_P0.6mm or AMS_OLGA-8_2x3.1mm_P0.8mm.
Prefer tier A part CCS811 when higher quality tiering is required.
avoid_when: The design requires non-SMD mounting types such as through-hole.
The required component uses a communication interface other than I2C.
The required footprint is not an AMS OLGA-8 or LGA-10 package.
